ITEM 1 | Open-faced slice of bread-like base, golden-brown to tan with darker toasted edges, roughly 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, sitting at the left-center of the plate, partly covered by toppings, slightly crisp-looking surface with visible crumb | 45
ITEM 2 | Flaky, pale off-white fish fillet pieces, moist-looking with a soft, separating texture, layered in two or three chunks about 4 cm each, with a small section of silvery-grey skin visible at the top edge, matte surface with slight sheen | 40
ITEM 3 | Pale greyish-blue fish skin piece with a glossy, slightly oily sheen, about 4 cm long, lying on top of the fillet near the top center of the topping, firm and intact | 15
ITEM 4 | Fresh green leafy herbs and sprigs, bright to dark green, scattered across the right and center of the topping, with thin wiry stems about 3 to 5 cm long, dry-looking, a few torn leaves about 1 to 2 cm across | 8
ITEM 5 | Small pale beige beans, roughly 1 to 1.5 cm across, smooth, slightly soft-looking with matte surface, a few scattered at the bottom edge and right side of the bread, one or two partly hidden under herbs | 10
ITEM 6 | Scattered crumbs and small light flecks of pale, moist residue on the plate beside the food, light beige, irregular, a few millimetres across | 2
